propositions: Epic close gate cannot distinguish between defects in the epic's own deliverable and legitimate pre-existing or deferred bugs; direct-children gate only sees child tasks, missing orphaned or cross-linked bugs filed during execution.

DET caused_by floor must block epic close when any open/in_progress bug records a caused_by edge into the epic subtree, with deterministic rejection teaching agents to fix, re-parent, or dispute the link.

Candidate filter identifies bugs to screen via two criteria: open/in_progress status AND (created after epic's first in_progress transition OR linked any-relation any-depth to subtree), capped at 32 with overflow recorded.

Haiku relevance screen evaluates each candidate against forced-choice ontology (defect-in-deliverable / pre-existing-adjacent / unrelated) using trivial model class, forwards A-verdicts as compact evidence (title+citation+id, max 8) into precheck fenced context.

Verifier adjudication blocks only undispositioned defects-in-deliverable, accepting store-grounded dispositions: (a) supersedes/duplicates link to epic subtree or successor, or (b) reasoned pre-existence/deferral prose in bug description/comments; screen failure degrades open instead of blocking.

Screen tally (per-bug verdict+citation) recorded in completion sidecar including unevaluated-overflow count; all regression fixtures (must-block 30a2/5b09, must-pass 30d3/e6a0/c8ed, not-flagged 5e94/22f5) proven through live calibration with real model and verifier disposition adjudication.
